COCO Caption Annotation Notice

Processing and changes:
  BrainHub distributed a processed ground-truth subset containing 4,913
  captions for 982 test images. HuPer packages that processed subset under a
  project-local path for evaluation. HuPer does not claim authorship of the
  captions and does not intentionally alter their text.

No endorsement by the COCO Consortium or BrainHub authors is implied.
